40022814.author: पदार्थः
40022814.content: एतत् आख्याय having narrated this, काकुत्स्थः Rama, भ्रातृभ्याम् to his two brothers, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, पुनः एव आह again indeed said, धर्मयुक्तम् इदं righteous this, वचः word.

40022814.author: Translation
40022814.content: Having narrated this, Rama of immeasurable splendor then again spoke these righteous words to Lakshmana in the presence of his brothers.

40022815.author: पदार्थः
40022815.content: वसिष्ठं Vasistha, वामदेवं Vamadeva, च and, जाबालिम् अथ Jabali and then, कश्यपम् Kashyapa, द्विजान् च Brahmins and, सर्वप्रवरान् all the chief, अश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान् those appointed for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

40022815.author: Translation
40022815.content: He spoke about inviting Vasistha, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kashyapa, and all other chief Brahmins who are appointed for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

40022816.author: पदार्थः
40022816.content: एतान् सर्वान् all these, समानीय having assembled, मन्त्रयित्वा having consulted, च and, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, हयं horse, लक्षणसम्पन्नं endowed with auspicious marks, विमोक्ष्यामि I shall release, समाधिना with proper ritual observance.

40022816.author: Translation
40022816.content: O Lakshmana, having assembled all these and consulted with them, I shall release a horse endowed with auspicious marks, with proper ritual observance.

40022817.author: पदार्थः
40022817.content: तत् वाक्यं that statement, राघवेण उक्तं spoken by Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, त्वरितविक्रमः of swift valor (Lakshmana), द्विजान् सर्वान् all the Brahmins, समाहूय having summoned, दर्शयामास showed, राघवम् to Rama.

40022817.author: Translation
40022817.content: Having heard that statement spoken by Rama, Lakshmana, of swift valor, summoned all the Brahmins and presented them to Rama.

40022818.author: पदार्थः
40022818.content: ते they, दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवसङ्काशं god-like, कृतपादाभिवन्दनम् one who had performed obeisance at their feet, राघवं Rama, सुदुराधर्षम् very difficult to overcome, आशीर्भिः with blessings, समपूजयन् they honored.

40022818.author: Translation
40022818.content: Having seen Rama, who was god-like, very difficult to overcome, and had just bowed at their feet, they honored him with their blessings.

40022819.author: पदार्थः
40022819.content: प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, स he, तदा then, भूत्वा having become, राघवः Rama, द्विजसत्तमान् to the best of the Brahmins, आचचक्षे he explained, अश्वमेधस्य of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, हि indeed, अभिप्रायं the intention, महायशाः the highly renowned one.

40022819.author: Translation
40022819.content: Then, the highly renowned Rama, with folded hands, explained his intention regarding the Ashwamedha sacrifice to the foremost Brahmins.

40022820.author: पदार्थः
40022820.content: ते they, तु indeed, रामस्य of Rama, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, नमस्कृत्वा having bowed down, वृषध्वजम् to Shiva, अश्वमेधं the Ashwamedha sacrifice, द्विजाः the Brahmins, सर्वे all, पूजयन्ति स्म they honored, सर्वशः in every way.

40022820.author: Translation
40022820.content: Having heard Rama's intention, all the Brahmins bowed down to Shiva and then honored the Ashwamedha sacrifice in every way.

40022821.author: पदार्थः
40022821.content: स he, तेषां of them, द्विजमुख्यानां of the chief Brahmins, वाक्यम् the words, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful insight, अश्वमेधाश्रितं related to the Ashwamedha, श्रुत्वा having heard, भृशं greatly, प्रीतः pleased, अभवत् became, तदा then.

40022821.author: Translation
40022821.content: Then, having heard the words of wonderful insight from those chief Brahmins regarding the Ashwamedha, he (Rama) became greatly pleased.

40022822.author: पदार्थः
40022822.content: विज्ञाय having understood, कर्म the decision, तत् that, तेषां of them, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् he said, प्रेषयस्व send, द्रुतं quickly, दूतान् messengers, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, महात्मने to the great-souled one.

40022822.author: Translation
40022822.content: Having understood their decision, Rama then said to Lakshmana, "Send messengers quickly to the great-souled Sugriva."

40022823.author: पदार्थः
40022823.content: यथा as, महद्भिः with great, हरिभिः monkeys, बहुभिः many, च and, वनौकसाम् of forest dwellers, सार्धम् together with, आगच्छ come, भद्रं ते may you be well, हि indeed, अनुभोक्तुम् to enjoy, महोत्सवम् the great festival.

40022823.author: Translation
40022823.content: Come with many great forest-dwelling monkeys to indeed enjoy this great festival, and may you be well.

40022824.author: पदार्थः
40022824.content: बिभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, रक्षोभिः with Rakshasas, कामगैः who can go anywhere at will, बहुभिः many, वृतः surrounded, अश्वमेधम् the Ashwamedha, महायज्ञम् great sacrifice, आयातु let him come, अतुलविक्रमः of unequalled valor.

40022824.author: Translation
40022824.content: Let Vibhishana, of unequalled valor, come to the great Ashwamedha sacrifice, surrounded by many Rakshasas who can travel at will.

40022825.author: पदार्थः
40022825.content: राजानः kings, च and, महाभागाः highly fortunate ones, ये who, मे my, प्रियचिकीर्षवः desirous of doing good, सानुगाः with their followers, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आयान्तु let them come, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, द्रष्टुम् to see, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.

40022825.author: Translation
40022825.content: Let all the highly fortunate kings who wish me well come quickly with their followers to witness this unsurpassed sacrifice.

40022826.author: पदार्थः
40022826.content: देशान्तरगताः gone to other countries, ये who, च and, द्विजाः Brahmins, धर्मसमाहिताः devoted to dharma, आमन्त्रयस्व invite, तान्सर्वान् all of them, अश्वमेधाय for the Ashwamedha, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana.

40022826.author: Translation
40022826.content: Lakshmana, invite all those Brahmins who are devoted to dharma and have gone to other countries for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

40022827.author: पदार्थः
40022827.content: ऋषयः sages, च and, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, आहूयन्ताम् let them be invited, तपोधनाः whose wealth is penance, देशान्तरगताः gone to other countries, सर्वे all, सदाराः with their wives, च and, द्विजातयः Brahmins, तथैव similarly, तालावचराः musicians, तथैव similarly, नटनर्तकाः actors and dancers.

40022827.author: Translation
40022827.content: O mighty-armed one, let all sages whose wealth is penance, all Brahmins who have gone to other countries along with their wives, and similarly musicians, actors, and dancers be invited.

40022828.author: पदार्थः
40022828.content: yajñavāṭaḥ sacrificial enclosure, ca and, sumahān very large, gomatyā near Gomati, naimiśe vane in Naimisha forest, ājñāpyatāṃ let it be arranged, mahābāho O mighty-armed one, tat that, hi indeed, puṇyam meritorious, anuttamam unsurpassed.

40022828.author: Translation
40022828.content: O mighty-armed one, let a very large sacrificial enclosure be arranged in the Naimisha forest near the Gomati river, for that indeed is an unsurpassed meritorious act.

40022829.author: पदार्थः
40022829.content: śāntayaḥ peace rites, ca and, mahābāho O mighty-armed one, pravartyantāṃ let them be performed, samantataḥ all around.

40022829.author: Translation
40022829.content: And O mighty-armed one, let peace rites be performed everywhere.

40022830.author: पदार्थः
40022830.content: śataśaḥ by hundreds, ca and, api also, dharmajñāḥ knowers of dharma, kratumukhyam chief of sacrifices, anuttamam unsurpassed, anubhūya having experienced, mahāyajñaṃ the great sacrifice, naimiśe in Naimisha, raghunandana O delight of the Raghus.

40022830.author: Translation
40022830.content: O delight of the Raghus, let hundreds of knowers of dharma, having experienced this great and unsurpassed chief of sacrifices in Naimisha...

40022831.author: पदार्थः
40022831.content: tuṣṭaḥ satisfied, puṣṭaḥ nourished, ca and, sarvaḥ all, asau that (people), mānitaḥ honored, ca and, yathāvidhi according to custom, prītiṃ joy, yāsyati will attain, dharmajña O knower of dharma, śīghram quickly, āmantryatāṃ let them be invited, janaḥ people.

40022831.author: Translation
40022831.content: O knower of dharma, let all those people be quickly invited, so that they will be satisfied, nourished, and properly honored, thereby attaining great joy.

40022832.author: पदार्थः
40022832.content: śatam a hundred, vāhasahasrāṇām of thousands of cartloads, taṇḍulānām of rice grains, vapuṣmatām excellent, ayutam ten thousand, tilamudgānām of sesame and mung beans, prayātu let it go, agre in front, mahābala O mighty one.

40022832.author: Translation
40022832.content: O mighty one, let a hundred thousand cartloads of excellent rice grains and ten thousand cartloads of sesame and mung beans be sent ahead.

40022833.author: पदार्थः
40022833.content: चणकानां of chickpeas, कुलित्थानां of horse gram, माषाणां of black gram, लवणस्य of salt, च and, अतः therefore, अनुरूपं suitable, स्नेहं oil, च and, गन्धं spices, सङ्क्षिप्तम् collected, एव indeed, च and.

40022833.author: Translation
40022833.content: Therefore, suitable oil and collected spices, along with chickpeas, horse gram, black gram, and salt, should also be taken.

40022834.author: पदार्थः
40022834.content: सुवर्णकोट्यः crores of gold, बहुलाः many, हिरण्यस्य of gold, शतोत्तराः hundreds more, अग्रतः in front, भरतः Bharata, कृत्वा having placed, गच्छतु let him go, अग्रे forward, समाधिना with careful arrangement.

40022834.author: Translation
40022834.content: Bharata should go forth at the head, having placed many crores of gold and hundreds more of other gold wealth, with careful arrangement.

40022835.author: पदार्थः
40022835.content: अन्तरा along the way, पण्यवीथ्यः market streets, च and, सर्वे all, च and, नटनर्तकाः actors and dancers, सूदाः cooks, नार्यः women, च and, बहवः many, नित्यं always, यौवनशालिनः youthful.

40022835.author: Translation
40022835.content: Along the way, there should be market streets, and all actors and dancers, as well as many cooks and perpetually youthful women.

40022836.author: पदार्थः
40022836.content: भरतेन with Bharata, तु indeed, सार्धं together, ते they, यान्तु let them go, सैन्यानि armies, च and, अग्रतः in front, नैगमाः merchants, बलवृद्धाः strong and old, च and, द्विजाः Brahmins, च and, सुसमाहिताः well-prepared.

40022836.author: Translation
40022836.content: Indeed, let the armies go forth with Bharata, and also the merchants, the strong and old, and the well-prepared Brahmins.

40022837.author: पदार्थः
40022837.content: कर्मान्तिकान् workers, वर्धकिनः carpenters, कोशाध्यक्षांश्च and treasurers, नैगमान् merchants, मम my, मातः mothers, तथा similarly, सर्वाः all, कुमारान्तःपुराणि inner chambers of princes, च and.

40022837.author: Translation
40022837.content: Also, workers, carpenters, treasurers, merchants, all my mothers, and the inner chambers of the princes should similarly accompany them.

40022838.author: पदार्थः
40022838.content: काञ्चनीं golden, मम my, पत्नीं wife, च and, दीक्षायां in the initiation, ज्ञांश्च and those who know, कर्मणि in the ritual, अग्रतः in front, भरतः Bharata, कृत्वा having placed, गच्छतु let him go, अग्रे in front, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.

40022838.author: Translation
40022838.content: Rama commanded that the greatly renowned Bharata should proceed first, carrying his golden idol of Sita, who represented his wife for the initiation, and also leading those who were knowledgeable in the rituals.

40022839.author: पदार्थः
40022839.content: उपकार्याः temporary dwellings, महार्हाः very valuable, च and, पार्थिवानां for the kings, महौजसाम् of great might, सानुगानां along with their followers, नरश्रेष्ठः the best among men, व्यादिदेश commanded, महाबलः the mighty one.

40022839.author: Translation
40022839.content: The mighty Rama, the best among men, commanded that splendid temporary dwellings be arranged for the powerful kings and their retinues. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 91 ।। Thus ends the ninety-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
